ns2:course.label: Elementary Spanish II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of SPAN 101. Students continue developing basic listening, speaking, reading and writing skills in Spanish and awareness of the various cultures of the Spanish-speaking world, including the US. This is considered a second level course for the purposes of fulfilling the Language Other Than English (LOTE) requirement. Instruction in Spanish. Credit is not given towards graduation for both SPAN 102 and SPAN 122; students who have the equivalent of four or more years credit in Spanish at the secondary level will not receive credit towards graduation for SPAN 102. Prerequisite: SPAN 101 or equivalent.
